data.gender_notes: Gopee is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who constantly offers prayers and oblations to the gods. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'go-pā' meaning 'to please the gods'. The name Gopee carries the meaning “Worshipper of God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gopee usually hope their child will grow to embody worshipper of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Gopee belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Worshipper of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gopee total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

Gopee signifies one who is constantly in the service of the Divine, nurturing and protecting the divine essence within ourselves and others.

historical_references.reference: Gopee is a Hindu name associated with the ancient Indian epic Mahabharata. The character Gopee is a Yaksha or nature spirit, who appears in the epic as a guardian of the forest and a friend to the Pandava brothers.
